reference_role: Each element's master-baby.png was used as the exact lineage and style reference.
shared_prompt: Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #FF00FF chroma-key background, one uniform color only. Style: authentic hand-pixeled 16-bit pixel art, limited palette, crisp hard pixel clusters, consistent dark outline, no antialiasing, no painterly texture. Composition: exactly one full-body character, strict side view facing left, neutral grounded standing pose, centered square canvas, complete silhouette filling about 68-72% of the safe envelope, feet on one baseline, generous magenta margin on all sides. Same upper-left lighting as the reference. Constraints: use the image just shown as the visual reference; preserve its lineage identity, palette, markings, face family, pixel density and outline weight while changing only age progression and mature proportions. Entire creature fully visible. No frame, border, text, UI, watermark, cast shadow, ground, reflection, scenery, egg, extra pose, or floating detached effect. No edge touching. Do not use #FF00FF inside the creature.

requests.neutral: Create the Adult evolution of this same neutral-element Stegosaurus: longer body and tail, stronger legs, larger classic back plates and tail spikes, confident but friendly expression. Preserve natural olive-green and warm amber palette and mottled markings. No magic or elemental effects.
requests.fire: Create the Adult evolution of this same fire-element Carnotaurus: taller and more muscular with mature skull proportions, larger paired brow horns, longer powerful legs and tail, and a confident fierce-but-friendly expression. Preserve charcoal-black scales, glowing lava-red fissure markings and attached ember-like dorsal spines; no detached flames, sparks, smoke or aura.
requests.grass: Create the Adult evolution of this same grass-element Brachiosaurus: clearly taller with a long elegant neck, sturdier pillar legs, longer tail and mature gentle face. Preserve bright leaf-green scales, cream belly, vine curls, and leaves/buds physically attached as scale growth; add a slightly fuller leafy crown but no detached leaves, pollen or aura.
requests.ground: Create the Adult evolution of this same ground-element Ankylosaurus: broader lower armored body, stronger short legs, larger layered rock plates and a clearly enlarged stone tail club, with a calm determined expression. Preserve sandstone/ochre palette and geological armor language; no detached rocks, dust, cracks on the ground or aura.
requests.electric: Create the Adult evolution of this same electric-element Parasaurolophus: taller athletic hadrosaur build, longer tail and legs, mature muzzle and a much more distinctive backward lightning-bolt cranial crest. Preserve vivid golden yellow, cobalt blue accents, white belly and attached zigzag charge markings; no detached lightning, sparks or aura.
requests.water: Create the Adult evolution of this same water-element Spinosaurus: longer low crocodilian snout, larger semi-aquatic body and tail, stronger legs, enlarged turquoise wave-pattern sail and clearly attached fin structures. Preserve deep blue/cyan palette and scale texture; no detached water, bubbles, splashes or aura.
requests.ice: Create the Adult evolution of this same ice-element Pachyrhinosaurus: broader quadruped body, heavier legs, mature beak and nasal boss, and a larger crystalline frill with attached icy plates. Preserve pale blue-white palette, snowflake marking and frosted scale language; no detached snowflakes, ice shards, mist or aura.
requests.dragon: Create the Adult evolution of this same dragon-element Tyrannosaurus: larger powerful T. rex anatomy with massive head, muscular hind legs and counterbalancing tail, mature dragon horns and attached dorsal ridges while unmistakably retaining tiny two-finger arms. Preserve crimson-red scales, golden belly and dark volcanic markings; no wings, detached fire, smoke or aura.
requests.dark: Create the Adult evolution of this same dark-element feathered Velociraptor: taller lean predatory body, elongated tail, stronger sickle-clawed legs and layered raven-like feathers, with an alert intelligent expression. Preserve midnight navy/black palette, pale eye mask and crescent-moon flank marking; no detached shadow, smoke, feathers, moon, particles or aura.
